title: Crisp Socca with Onions, Rosemary and Black Olives
summary: A rested chickpea-flour batter is poured into a very hot pan over browned onions and rosemary, dotted with olives, baked until set and grilled until spotted brown.
equipment: 30 cm cast-iron frying pan or round pizza tin

ingredients.item: besan (finely milled chickpeas, also sold as gram)
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Make the batter
steps.text: Whisk the besan, salt and pepper, then slowly whisk in the water until smooth. Stir in 2 tbsp oil, cover and rest at least 30 minutes.

steps.title: Heat the pan
steps.text: Put the pan in the oven and heat to 230 °C (210 °C fan).

steps.title: Brown the onions
steps.text: Add 2 tbsp oil and the onions to the hot pan and return to the oven for 6-8 minutes, stirring once, until browned. Stir in the rosemary.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Stir the onions into the batter, pour back into the hot pan, dot with olives and rosemary sprigs, and bake 12-15 minutes until firm with crisp edges.

steps.title: Brown the top
steps.text: Brush with the remaining oil and grill 1-2 minutes until browned in spots.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Cut into wedges and serve hot or warm.

tips: A screaming-hot pan gives the crisp edges.
Resting the batter lets the besan hydrate for a creamier middle.
The batter should be as thin as single cream; add a splash of water if it has thickened.
storage: Best eaten warm. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour, eat within 3 days and reheat in a hot oven until piping hot. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
